## Introduction

This ecosystem assessment tool from the EcoCAT project is designed for users who already have maps of ecosystems or habitats that they want perform an ecosystem assessment on following the [IUCN Red List of Ecosystem assessment guidelines](https://portals.iucn.org/library/sites/library/files/documents/2024-021-En.pdf "pdf file of the RLE ecosytem assessment guidelines"){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}. This tool can generate the following:

-   Descriptive information of a mapped ecosystem

-   Criterion A (temporal change) - only when \>1 time period of data is uploaded

-   Criterion B (Area and extent of occurrence)

The ecosystem assessment tool will help provide standardised ecosystem assessments, to ensure ecosystem status are comparable across all assessed ecosystems.

For additional information on the project including the team involved and other tools in development (e.g. an ecosystem mapping tool), please visit the [RBG Kew project webpage](https://www.kew.org/science/our-science/projects/EcoCAT "url link to the RBG Kew project webpage"){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}.

## Methods

### Descriptive data

#### Rainfall

Historical rainfall data is currently extracted from [WorldClim verison 2.1](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html "url link to the worldclim datasets"){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} at a 2.5 minute resolution

#### Temperature

Historical temperature data is currently extracted from [WorldClim verison 2.1](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html "url link to the worldclim datasets"){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} at a 2.5 minute resolution.
